pairs.summary: Ahr::Arnt and PAX1 motifs co-occur in the same accessible ~300 bp windows more often than expected after matching GC, accessibility and repeat content, in 7 of 14 profiles analysed (786-O clear-cell renal carcinoma; HepG2 hepatoblastoma/liver cancer; MDA-MB-468 triple-negative breast cancer; SW620 colorectal adenocarcinoma (metastasis); ...). Median lift 1.32x, typical spacing ~48 bp between sites. In 6 profile(s) the enrichment is seen in both replicate halves and the motifs are distinguishable. Caution: dimer motif — the signal may reflect one family/shared motif rather than two distinct factors. This is a sequence-level hypothesis to test (e.g. ChIP/CUT&RUN co-binding, motif mutagenesis), not a confirmed interaction.
